context: A drama teacher coaches a teen for a lead role
purpose: Teach: 演劇/女優/主演/演じ/フィルム/台詞/パーティー/エピソード

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今度の演劇、あなたを主演に抜擢したの。覚悟はできてる?
lines.en: For the next play, I've cast you in the lead role. Are you ready?
lines.style: Warm but firm, encouraging mentor tone with quiet authority

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えっ、私が主役の女優ですか?信じられない…台詞、ちゃんと覚えられるかな。
lines.en: Wait, me as the lead actress? I can't believe it... I wonder if I can memorize all the lines.
lines.style: Surprised teenage voice, breathless and slightly anxious mid-sentence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 大丈夫。長い台詞でも、感情と一緒に体で覚えれば自然と出てくるから。
lines.en: It'll be fine. Even long lines come out naturally if you learn them with emotion and your body.
lines.style: Calm, reassuring teaching voice with steady measured pacing

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生は昔、フィルム映画にも出てたんですよね?どんな役を演じてたんですか?
lines.en: Sensei, you used to act in film movies too, right? What kind of roles did you play?
lines.style: Curious teenage tone, leaning in with genuine fascination

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ふふ、昔の話よ。撮影中の面白いエピソードなら、いくらでもあるけどね。
lines.en: Hehe, that's old news. But I do have plenty of funny episodes from those shoots.
lines.style: Nostalgic chuckle, soft and slightly self-deprecating laughter

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 聞きたいです!打ち上げパーティーの時にでも、ぜひ話してください。
lines.en: I want to hear them! Please tell me at the wrap party or something.
lines.style: Bright excited teen voice with eager pleading energy

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いいわよ。でもまずは本番。あなたなら立派な主演女優になれる。私が保証する。
lines.en: Sure. But first, the performance. You can become a wonderful lead actress. I guarantee it.
lines.style: Confident mentor tone shifting to warm, firm reassurance
